console.note: list_console_messages(types=[error,warn]) returned no messages after full sweep; ended at Sol, nav closed.

anomalies: NAV MECHANIC DEVIATION (applied to all 5 vantages): synthetic Escape KeyboardEvent dispatched on window did NOT drop the nav level from 4->3 (search-input focus swallowed it; clearing+blurring did not help). Drove the documented PRISM transition by calling window._navComputer.handleEscape() directly — the exact handler an Escape key invokes, so semantically ONE Escape. _localStars populated normally after this.

STALE NAV POSITION (applied to all 5 vantages): after a search-warp, the nav computer's internal player position (_playerX/_playerY/_playerZ, _currentSystemName) remained pointed at the PRE-warp system, so entering PRISM left _localStars=0 (loadedYMin/bgLoadTimer null, load never kicked). First observed at Sol: _currentSystemName stuck at boot system 'Bespop-31FQHW4D1M'. Fixed by nc.deactivate() then reopen via N key, which refreshed player position to the arrived vantage (verified: playerX matched each vantage's battery coords exactly) BEFORE handleEscape()->PRISM. This close+reopen was done every vantage.

CLOSE AFFORDANCE: the only DOM '×' inside .nav-computer-panel is button.overlay-close rendered 0x0 at (0,0) (UI is canvas-drawn). DOM .click() on it acted as 'back one level' at PRISM (3->4) and did nothing at level 4. Final panel close done via nc.deactivate(); confirmed closed (HUD reverted to 'HELM', panel offsetParent=null, warp idle, seed 'sol').

SUITE RETURN SHAPE: window.__wd.runIntegrationSuite() returns an OBJECT {passed:19, failed:0, total:19, results:[...]}, NOT a bare array. Per-result field is 'passed' (bool) as documented. 19/19 passed, 0 failed.

BATTERY HAD NO 'structures' KEY: the 10 structure names for step D were taken from battery.counts.componentBreakdown.structureNames=10 = the deep-sky tail of mustResolve: M42,M1,M13,M57,M45,M8,M17,M20,M16,NGC2237. All 10 resolved to correct named deep-sky objects (Orion/Crab/Great Hercules Cluster/Ring/Pleiades/Lagoon/Omega/Trifid/Eagle/Rosette) with a span.nav-search-kind label; no data-* attributes on rows.
Boot-tour landing system before first warp = procgen 'Bespop-31FQHW4D1M' (B star, seed 3165486405), non-binary — expected, not Sol.
First warp to Sol cycled warp state idle->exit->idle within ~300ms (fast/near-instant); subsequent interstellar warps showed the full idle->fold->enter->hyper->idle sequence over ~8-20s.

FIDELITY RESULT: across all 5 vantages, EVERY isReal star's measuredPc (entry.dist*1000) matched expectedPc (euclidean vantage->catalog distance *1000) to worst errPct = 0.0 (all non-self entries exact). 0 stars over 2% error, 0 isReal names missing from the hyg+supplement catalogs, at every vantage.
